title: feat(agents): Refine overview charts and controls
body: Behind `gen-ai-agents-overview`, the agents overview now keeps table search below the tabs, moves the chart interval selector into the page actions, and keeps table search terms out of chart queries. Estimated Cost appears first; when a time range contains LLM calls but no agent or tool spans, it becomes the only chart and a setup banner links to the agent tracing documentation. Chart rendering waits for span-type detection to avoid a three-chart flicker. Completely empty time ranges retain the single empty cost chart without showing the setup banner, so the guidance only appears when LLM spans are actually present.
